$comment: Workspace packages the application declares as dependencies and never imports, each naming the feature that will consume it. `scripts/verify-dead-exports.mjs` fails on an unused package that is NOT listed here, AND on a listing that IS imported or whose feature is already done. Same shape and same reason as unreached-tokens.json and unreachable-routes.json (ADR-0088). THE WHOLE LIST PRINTS ON EVERY RUN.
$readingComment: A package listed here builds, tests and passes every gate — and the product never calls it. That is the failure mode this file exists to make visible, and it is invisible by construction otherwise: the tests check the package, and nothing checks that anything uses it.

unused.why: Twelve harmony generators — monochromatic, tonal, analogous, complementary, split, triadic, tetradic, neutral, near-neutral, warm-cool, value-contrast, chroma-contrast — every one gamut-mapped, carrying the cost of the mapping, and covered by gate 5. Shipped complete in F-014 and imported by ZERO application files ever since. It is the engine behind the colour combinations this whole release is for, and F-194 is the feature that finally calls it.

The Zod schemas that are, in F-002's words, 'the single source of runtime validation and of the TypeScript types derived from them'. The app validates nothing at runtime today because nothing crosses a trust boundary — there is no server and no API (ADR-0051) — and the one thing that will is F-196's curated combination records, which are content the corpus loader parses. NOT A SLIP: the package is right and the consumer arrives with the first data the app reads rather than computes.
